rows.text: • Expect full year fiscal 2027 sales growth of between 5.5% and 9.5% and EPS between $4.22 to $4.38, inclusive of $0.12 of dilution from Facet acquisition
Full-year EPS is forecast to be between $4.22 and $4.38, including approximately $0.12 of dilution from Facet and compared with fiscal 2026 GAAP and adjusted EPS of $3.85 and $3.98, respectively.
